itransformer.name: itransformer
itransformer.display_name: iTransformer (Liu et al., ICLR 2024) — aligned, with disclosed deviations
evidence: backbones/itransformer.py:34 variate embedding = shared Linear(T -> d_model)
backbones/itransformer.py:43-47 TransformerEncoder over variate TOKENS => cross-variate attention
backbones/itransformer.py:41,47 shared Linear(d_model -> L) head per variate
backbones/itransformer.py:36-40 norms are only the encoder layer's own LayerNorms

deviations.deviation: no per-variate InstanceNorm/RevIN layer (paper normalises the variate representations)
adds a learnable PER-VARIATE positional embedding; the published iTransformer uses NO positional encoding (it is permutation-invariant over variates)

itransformer.notes: core inversion (variate-as-token) + cross-variate attention + shared Linear(D->L) head match the paper, but the missing instance normalisation and the ADDED per-variate positional encoding are deviations; the PE deviation is recorded here explicitly.
